scope: second-pass targeted source search for eight records with incomplete photographic evidence
sourcesPriority: Wikimedia Commons image-page license where available

entries.name: Phlegmacium variiforme
entries.note: Search of exact name and historic Cortinarius combination not enough to assert identity. Require specialist source and 3 separate views.

entries.name: Entoloma saundersii
entries.note: Wikimedia Commons lists Entoloma saundersii 515187.jpg; image page must be checked for precise license, identification and perspectives.

entries.name: Ramaria formosa
entries.note: AMINT lists various photos by named authors, including branch colour closeups. Verify photo rights and three distinct useful views.

entries.name: Ramaria pallida
entries.note: AMINT lists several named photographers and observations. Verify photograph-specific license and specimen determination.

entries.name: Ramaria botrytis s.l.
entries.note: Multiple photos and diagnostic text. Guide ragionata remains governing authority for food class/preparation.

entries.name: Ramaria
entries.note: Genus-level photos depict different Ramaria species, make explicit grouped-identification task without assigning one edibility to all.

entries.name: Morchella
entries.note: Comparison includes Morchella and Verpa, attachment differences. Genus case needs representative species labeling, not pretend one specimen proves genus.

entries.name: Verpa
entries.note: BioImages CC BY-NC-SA restrictions are not suitable by default for commercially distributed app. Use as research only pending permission.

rightsPolicy: Do not download, copy, republish images without explicit compatible license or permission; source presence never proves reuse rights.
foodPolicy: No reclassification; use Guida ragionata and separately documented preparation.
